name: x1
long_description: x1 is an AI app builder that helps anyone create real, App Store-ready iOS apps. Users start with a structured product plan, design polished iPhone screens in a visual canvas, build features step by step, and prepare launch assets like App Store listings, screenshots, monetization, and analytics. Instead of generating one-shot AI demos, x1 gives builders a guided system for turning an idea into a real app.
one_liner: AI app builder for creating and launching iPhone apps

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
The first hour with an AI app builder is misleading. A user enters a prompt, gets polished screens and a functional first version, and thinks the app is nearly finished. The hard part begins later, when they add authentication, payments, user data, permissions, subscriptions, analytics, and the next 20 changes.

The problem is not that AI cannot generate code. It is that a real app is a connected system of product, design, data, and engineering decisions. When those decisions are not made explicitly, the AI guesses. Each guess may work on its own while conflicting with another part of the app, so every new feature makes the product harder to fix, test, and launch.

This matters because AI has opened app development to people who should not need to act as a product manager, designer, engineer, and QA lead at the same time. Existing tools give them generation without the structure needed to turn an idea into a durable product.

We started x1 after seeing the same pattern repeatedly: people could create an impressive demo quickly, then became trapped in prompt-and-fix loops. x1 asks the important questions first, turns the answers into a plan, lets users design the screens before development, builds in milestones, and verifies each step before moving on.

The goal is not just a faster demo. It is a working iPhone app that can keep improving.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
Our long-term vision is to make it possible for one person to build and run a serious app company.

Today, launching an app requires product planning, design, mobile engineering, backend infrastructure, testing, App Store operations, monetization, analytics, marketing, customer support, and ongoing iteration. AI can generate pieces of that work, but the founder still has to coordinate disconnected tools and repeatedly explain the product from scratch.

x1 will become the shared system for the entire app lifecycle. It will remember the product, users, design, data, and prior decisions, then carry that context into future releases, App Store assets, subscriptions, analytics, experiments, marketing, and customer feedback.

A founder should be able to go from an idea to an app, from an app to a launch, and from a launch to a growing business without assembling a traditional software team.

If we succeed, people with strong ideas, taste, domain expertise, or distribution will be able to create durable app businesses on their own. x1 will be the operating system for one-person app companies.
